entities.name: Dejan Majstorović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dejan Majstorović is a Serbian professional basketball player who is currently ranked world No. 2 in men's individual 3x3 rankings by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA). He plays for Ub Huishan NE and Serbia men's national 3x3 team. He is the most-decorated Serbian 3x3 basketball player, having earned five gold medals and one silver medal in World Cups.
